description: Reading an unbound `:missing` raises `ol-undefined-var` (issue #94, params `{ name }`); the read is decided statically, so the program does not run and no event is emitted at all; under the `runUnchecked` opt-out execution halts at the failing statement and only its `instruction` event is kept. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
